body.x: LAMI-TECH KOREA will participate in theworld’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan.7-10 to showcase its waterproof drone motor.

LAMI-TECH KOREA is the company specializing in producing special-purpose waterproof drone motors under the brand name K-MOTOR. Since the company's establishment in 2007, it has developed high-performance, high-reliability drones that have passed international waterproof standards (KOLAS IP43) with epoxy/polyimide insulation technology, and it will be exhibited in CES 2020.

With the performance from participating in the development of electric motor with KITECH, a national research institute, it is developing a 10KW drone motor for boarding with the funding from MSS. It is performing joint-research with KITECH, Yeongnam University, and Kyungwoon Univerisity.

The official said, "Based on the many patents and trademarks owned by LAMI-TECH KOREA, we are working on developing a multi-purpose drone with hydrogen fuel cell that has 110 kg payload and 8 hours flight time and autonomous driving."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
